text: 'O my Luve is like a red, red rose' (Robert Burns) — is line mein kaun sa figure of speech hai?
Simile mein do cheezon ke beech comparison ke liye aam taur par kaun se words ka istemaal hota hai?
Simile aur Metaphor mein mukhya antar kya hai?
options: Metaphor mein 'like/as' nahi hota, seedha comparison hota hai
Metaphor sirf jaanwaron ke liye use hota hai
Simile mein koi comparison hi nahi hota
Dono bilkul ek jaise hote hain
ans: Metaphor mein 'like/as' nahi hota, seedha comparison hota hai

text: 'All the world's a stage' (Shakespeare) — kaun sa figure of speech hai?
'Life's but a walking shadow' (Macbeth) — kaun sa figure of speech hai?

options: Ek cheez ko bina 'like/as' ke doosri cheez ke roop mein dikhaya jaata hai
Sirf dhwani ke shabdon ka istemaal hota hai
Kadwi baat narm shabdon mein kahi jaati hai
ans: Ek cheez ko bina 'like/as' ke doosri cheez ke roop mein dikhaya jaata hai

text: 'The wind whispered secrets to the trees' — kaun sa figure of speech hai?
Personification mein kya hota hai?
options: Nirjiv cheezon ya bhaavon ko insani gun diye jaate hain
Insaan ko jaanwar ke roop mein dikhaya jaata hai
Do virudh bhaavon ka mel hota hai
Shabdon ke shuru ke akshar repeat hote hain
ans: Nirjiv cheezon ya bhaavon ko insani gun diye jaate hain

text: 'The flowers danced in the gentle breeze' — is line mein kaun sa figure of speech hai?

text: 'Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers' — kaun sa figure of speech hai?

text: 'The fair breeze blew, the white foam flew' (Coleridge) — kaun sa figure of speech hai?

Shabdon ko ulta likha jaata hai
Do virudh shabd saath aate hain
Ek hisse ko poore ke liye use kiya jaata hai
ans: Shabd ki dhwani uske arth (sound) ki nakal karti hai

text: 'The moan of doves in immemorial elms' (Tennyson) — kaun sa figure of speech hai?

Do saman arth wale shabd saath aate hain
Ek hi shabd do baar aata hai
Baat ko ghuma-phira kar kahi jaati hai
ans: Do viprit arth wale shabd paas-paas aate hain
